name: Cenomi
verdict: Saudi mall operator (Cenomi Centers, formerly the Arabian Centres group) listed in Riyadh; largest disclosed holders are FAS Real Estate Co. and members of the Al Hokair family. Nothing found.
note: Sleeve badge on Al-Taawoun's 2026-27 home kit (three-year club deal announced 2026-04-02, visible on the sleeve in the club's launch photos); Al-Ahli back sponsor.
